questions.stem: In a graph of photosynthesis rate against light intensity, there are two curves: one at normal CO2 and one at higher CO2. The higher CO2 curve plateaus at a higher rate. What does this show?

options.text: Light is not needed for photosynthesis
CO2 concentration was a limiting factor at normal levels
Temperature has no effect on photosynthesis
The plant had more chlorophyll at higher CO2

questions.explanation: The higher plateau at increased CO2 shows that carbon dioxide concentration was previously limiting the rate. Removing this limitation allowed a faster maximum rate.
